details:
Apologies for the long report. This is a bit of a weird bug, but it seems to be new in this latest beta version build 634 (as of 2018-10-02). Might depend on the avatar and/or the order trackers are turned on. It is reproducible on my avatars 

The bug has a few consequences. In addition to spewing exceptions into the output_log (I have included the first such examples at the end), I notice the following symptoms:

- full-body IK tracking works perfectly fine from my perspective, but everybody else sees me as a desktop user (no arm/leg/hip tracking, only head moves around). If I am in the system menu, people see my avatar frozen in place even if I am moving.

- animations, such as walking, crouching, prone do not work from my perspective when using 3P Holoport or d+pad movement. My avatar freeze poses completely and looks like it is gliding while using movement, even if prone. Other players see me walking normally

- emotes work for me but appear as if they are additive against my full body pose. For example, backflip looks like I am doing a high kick and some emotes cause my legs to float off the ground, even ones that shouldn't be moving the legs. Other people see my emotes normally.

- if I turn off trackers such that I have 3-point IK (hands/head) or 4-point IK (hip tracker), it works fine. I was able to restore full motion by turning all my trackers on again (may have had to try twice) and switching avatars again. This bug seems to happen every time I open the beta client, unless I turn off the controllers and turn them back on again to cancel the first T-pose, then switch avatars.

Below is a relevant snippet of my output log. I will email or attach my full logs from multiple runs where I encountered the problem.
